CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing relation to content present; A absent.

COD.rationale: Contents (color at coordinates) are identified, their presentation/organization (current vs candidate, node structure) is given, and separate origin/status fields distinguish content identification from status.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing relation linking attention to the named content/presentation.

C.rationale: Report explicitly lists identified contents (red/blue) with coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields (completed_record, executed_branch_claim:false, inherited_current) separately mark the status/organization relative to the identified contents.

O.rationale: The report organizes contents into nodes and candidate branches and labels them as current or conditional, indicating how the content is presented/organized/accessed.
